title: refactor(service-automation): move executeWithoutRetry and the run-variable seeders into dag-traversal.ts (#25222 slice 4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuCEzLkAB12FfRHL9ipwfKPd)_

Part of #25222
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160

Slice 4 of the `engine.ts` split. The claim is 6374967743. The bodies of three `AutomationEngine` methods move, unedited, into `packages/services/service-automation/src/dag-traversal.ts`, the module slice 3 (#25531) made:

- `executeWithoutRetry`, one attempt of a run;
- `seedDeclaredVariables` and `seedRunVariables`, which seed a run's variables.

The change is move-only, and the card stays open for the later slices. Branch: `claude/project-thread-nirtwt`, the harness-pinned branch for this session, restarted from `main` at `5ea211cc` after slice 3 merged as `d7ccdfcd`. The branch name has no issue number, so the claim comment is the identity record.

## Scope

- **`retryExecution` stays in the class.** The seat's slice-4 list named it, and this slice narrows that list by one, as the claim states.
  - `packages/spec/liveness/flow.json` cites `engine.ts` for `flow/errorHandling.backoffMs`, `.backoffMultiplier` and `.maxRetryDelayMs`. Only `retryExecution`'s body names those three keys, in its destructuring of `errorHandling`.
  - Measured on a draft that moved it, `check:liveness` key-mention goes red: 749 of 753 pairs anchored, those 3 UNANCHORED.
  - The ledger is the spec lane's file, so this slice does not re-point it. The body stays, as `getConnectorDescriptors` stayed in slice 2.
- **The 33-site question.** The ruling on the 33 `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` sites in 21 methods is still pending with Sales. This slice moves **0** of them: none of the three bodies holds one. `check-tenant-audit-census` and `check-system-context-census` give byte-identical output at base and head (see Readers).
- **Return types.** The three methods are private, and each declares its return type.
- **Size.** 826 changed lines, under the 3,000-line bar.

## What stays in `engine.ts`

- Every moved method keeps its name, docblock, signature and position in the class, because tsup emits each member, private ones included, into the published `.d.ts`.
- `retryExecution`, for the reason above, and the section's other members, as slice 3 left them.

## The shape (slices 1 to 3, one host interface)

- `DagTraversalHost` gains the 11 members these bodies read, each typed as the class member itself (`AutomationEngine['m']`), so a renamed member is a compile error. There is no cast, and no member becomes public or protected. The interface now has 22 members.
- Each moved function types `this` as the `Pick` of `DagTraversalHost` over exactly the members its own body reads, read off each body's AST in first-read order. `seedDeclaredVariables` reads no member, so it is called directly, without a host.
- Methods are passed as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`, so a spy or test double set on the instance is still the one called.
- Fields are passed by value. There are two: `logger`, as in slice 3, and the `flows` map, assigned once at its declaration and never reassigned anywhere in the repo, tests included. So a host's field is the engine's field, including where the async body reads it after an `await`.
- **Async.** `executeWithoutRetry`'s stub drops `async` and returns the moved function's promise, as in slice 3. The caller gets the very promise the body makes. Dropping `async` is the only edit to that signature line, and the `.d.ts` does not print `async`.
- The moved bodies keep saying `this.`, so the moved lines are unedited.

## Module-level declarations and imports

- **Shared with code that stays, exported in place.** `buildRunTrigger` and the `ExecutionLogEntry` interface each gain `export`, as `FlowSuspendSignal` did in slice 3. `index.ts` re-exports `./engine.js` by name, so the package entry is unchanged; the export lists and the `.d.ts` below prove it.
- **The module's imports.**
  - From `./engine.js` it adds `buildRunTrigger`, by value, and `type ExecutionLogEntry`. `buildRunTrigger` is read only inside a function body, at call time, so the existing note on the import cycle covers it.
  - It adds `AutomationResult`, `readCarriedRefusal`, `summarizeRun` and `describeThrownForLog`. Each is still read in `engine.ts` too, so no `engine.ts` import line changes except the `./dag-traversal.js` import, which gains the three names.
- **Authored text.** Two sentences of the module docblock, and the comment above the `./dag-traversal.js` import in `engine.ts`, now name the new bodies.

## Proof of move-only

- **Moved block** (`git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change 5ea211cc HEAD` over the two files): 367 of the 380 deleted lines and 375 of the 446 added lines are detected as moved.
  - Deleted, not moved (13): in the module, the six docblock lines and two import lines that are rewritten; in `engine.ts`, the two comment lines above the `./dag-traversal.js` import, the heads of `ExecutionLogEntry` and `buildRunTrigger`, which gain `export`, and `executeWithoutRetry`'s head, which drops `async`.
  - Added, not moved (71): their replacements, the module's new import lines, the 11 host members, the three pointer docblocks and rewritten signature heads, the `./dag-traversal.js` import's three names, and the three stub bodies. The rest are lines such as a blank or a closing brace that git does not pair with a moved block.
- **An independent check** (a script over base and head `engine.ts` and base and head `dag-traversal.ts`):
  - 384 of the 415 lines added to the module are in 4 verbatim runs of base `engine.ts`, the three method texts de-indented one level. It names each of the other 31: 6 docblock lines, 6 import lines, 11 host members, 3 pointer docblocks and 5 signature lines (three `export function` heads and two `this` parameter lines, each a `Pick` of the host).
  - Every line deleted from `engine.ts` is among the lines added to the module, apart from the 5 rewritten lines above (372 deleted, 10 of them blank).
  - 23 of the 31 lines added to `engine.ts` are found nowhere in base: the rewritten comment, the three import names, the two `export` heads, the head without `async`, and the stub lines. The other 8 are lines such as `logger: this.logger,` and `};` that base already contains elsewhere.
  - The 8 lines deleted from the module are the docblock and import lines it rewrites; no slice-3 body line changes.
  - No string or template literal in the three method bodies spans a line (checked on the TypeScript AST of base `engine.ts`), so de-indenting changed no string value.
- **`.d.ts`**: see the next section.
- **Bundles**: the ESM and CJS export lists are identical, 39 names each at base and head, and ESM equals CJS on each side. `buildRunTrigger` and `ExecutionLogEntry` gain `export` inside the module graph only, so neither reaches the package entry. The bundle JS bytes differ because code moved within the bundle.
- **Tests**: `@objectstack/service-automation`'s suite passes the same at base and head, 199 files and 2628 tests.

## `.d.ts` reading (ruling 6348891160, item 2)

Base is `dist/` built at `5ea211cc` in this container, in a worktree of that commit. Head is `dist/` built at this PR's commit, with the package's dependencies built by `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/service-automation` (31 of 31 tasks). Both sides resolve the same built dependencies.

- raw sha256, `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` (identical to each other on both sides): base `1a5162a4dd929399460a3936e22747a74cf0a8db24d398ffbab5d7ead7bf212e`, head `1a5162a4dd929399460a3936e22747a74cf0a8db24d398ffbab5d7ead7bf212e`.
- normalised sha256, all four files: base `0df32585069f743135440763aabff8c23473231181297c8d164f5f7ee4f10232`, head `0df32585069f743135440763aabff8c23473231181297c8d164f5f7ee4f10232`.
- raw diff, `index.d.ts` base vs head: **0 lines** (19,626 lines each side). This slice reorders no union, so the normalised diff is empty too.
- the normaliser, the ruling's one-liner, verbatim:
  `node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum`
- positive controls on the head `index.d.ts`, line 5249, the private member whose body moved, one line each, then the same normaliser:
  - `private executeWithoutRetry;` made public (`executeWithoutRetry;`) gives `8683c058fc24e16c642af1815c0d43bfd1a2a461f5f3e36ce7b0a9704bbc75c4`.
  - the same member renamed (`private executeWithoutRetryRenamed;`) gives `81b389461bb213a6c5890a1e129b3c75ddd6d3b6a8054315ee6eda35dcf231bb`.
  - Both differ from `0df32585…`, so the normaliser hides neither kind of change.
- Item 1 holds: (a) the declaration set and visibility are the same; (b) the files are byte-identical, before and after the normalisation; (c) the ESM and CJS export lists are identical; (d) there is no raw-diff line.

## Readers

No reader needed re-pointing. `src/flow-activation-ledger.test.ts`'s `ENGINE_SOURCES` (the #10243 grep pins) has listed `./dag-traversal.ts` since slice 3.

**Readers examined:**

- `check-tenant-audit-census` (derived): output byte-identical to base `5ea211cc`. It certifies 238 write call sites (162 decidable; 2 provably without tenant context, 29 more unreadable), holds 23 prose figures, and matches every `UNTYPED_RECEIVERS` row. Its `--self-test` output is identical too.
- `check-system-context-census` (derived): output byte-identical. It finds 149 elevation read sites in 22 packages across 76 files, in 128 symbols.
- `check:liveness` (spec lane, not derived, run by hand as `packages/spec`'s `tsx scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts`): output identical at base and head. 753 (entry, cited file) pairs: 752 anchored, 1 exempt. 982 of 982 symbol anchors resolve.
  - `flow.json`'s `successMessage` row cites `engine.ts#executeWithoutRetry` and quotes `successMessage: flow.successMessage` from its body. The method stays as a shell, so the anchor resolves. `engine.ts` still names `successMessage` 8 times, so key-mention still holds.
  - The quoted line is now in the module, which the spec lane may re-point to at its own pace. `retryExecution`, which the next row cites, stays (see Scope).
- `check:platform-checklist` (not derived, run by hand): output identical at base and head. 987 of 997 symbol anchors resolved; the other 10 are the same ones, on the named #16898 residual. No checklist anchor names a moved method.
- `check-adr-symbol-anchors` (not derived, run by hand): output identical at base and head, 2384 anchors across 142 records resolve.
- `check:adr-anchors` (decision letters, run by hand): output byte-identical at base and head, with 83 anchored files, 52271 citations across 6676 files, and 1971 decision-letter citations. Neither `engine.ts` nor `dag-traversal.ts` is on the anchored surface (the package's one anchored file is `flow-precedence.ts`).
- `check:startup-registry-verdict` (not derived, run by hand): 46 seams, 40 read-only, none recording a verdict, at base and head. The scanned file count is 3448 at base and 3449 at head. The extra file is `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`, a git-ignored build output present only in the head worktree.
- No `path:line` citation in the repo points into the moved ranges of base `engine.ts` (the bodies `:11584` to `:12025`), or into `dag-traversal.ts`.
  - Lines of `engine.ts` from base `:125` up to the first moved body move down by 3. Lines after base `:12025` move up by 341.
  - The one live `service-automation/src/engine.ts:44` string, in `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/evidence.test.ts`, is a realm-attribution fixture that `scanEvidence` parses without reading the file.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on this commit derives 53 families from the 2 changed paths (826 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge threshold). All 53 ran in this container on this commit, each exit code captured before any pipe, and all 53 exit 0. `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles: 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Run by hand at base and head, not derived: `check:liveness`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check:adr-anchors` and `check:startup-registry-verdict`, with the readings in the readers section above.
- `@objectstack/service-automation`'s `vitest run`: 199 of 199 files, 2628 of 2628 tests, the same at base and head. `tsc --noEmit` and ESLint on the two files pass.
